SideSpeed 0.2.0 makes the TV app itself fast.

## What's new
- **SideSpeed optimizes itself.** After an install or update, SideSpeed compiles itself to `speed` the next time you leave the app, once the helper is running. The Apps screen shows **SideSpeed optimized** when that is done.
- **Baseline profile.** The APK now includes a baseline profile, which tells Android which code to compile first. This helps on TVs where the helper isn't running yet.
- **Smoother app list.** Holding the D-pad scrolls through the list at the full speed of your remote, with fewer dropped frames.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.2.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.0-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.0-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.0-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |

Each companion file is also attached under a name without the version, for links that always point at the latest release.

## Notes
- **Updating from 0.1.0:** install over the old version. Your settings and the TV's ADB approval are kept. Updating stops the helper, so start it again (Google TV / onn: just open SideSpeed).
- The companion apps have not changed since 0.1.0. The Android companion still reports version 0.1.0.
- Both APKs are signed with the project key, which has certificate SHA-256 `5d153f27c68102ff8245e8eb1c6c0a4d4a11d5e1976685824cecb0ce7108cc0c`.
- The desktop installers are unsigned. On macOS, right-click the app and choose **Open**. On Windows, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

See the [README](https://github.com/DevJardins/SideSpeed#readme) for setup.
